chapter: Rhythm Club memories and playing technique
title: Why Cole succeeded: luck and being on 52nd Street

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: Here's kind of what may seem an odd question to you, but did you ever stop to wonder maybe why you became the success that you did and perhaps some of these other guys didn't.

Well like I always said you know, I got some very nice breaks, I was very lucky. I was in the right place at the right time, at the time you know, I was there on 52nd Street, with Stuff, and then's when the recording industry was really jumping then, you know. There in the '30s and I was around and those different musicians saw me, the ones that did, liked the way I played and would call me on a record date.
I guess one thing led to another.
